result.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
result.comment: Coding agents, Trajectory collection, Agent training data, History-guided exploration, SWE-bench
result.summary: Coding agents solve repository issues through long sequences of exploration, editing, and validation. These trajectories are increasingly used as post-training data, so how they are collected shapes what the trained model learns. A common approach is to sample multiple trajectories independently for each issue and then select or curate them. However, as more trajectories are sampled independently, later trajectories become increasingly redundant, even though earlier trajectories could guide where subsequent collection effort should be spent. A natural way to use this history is to expose it to the coding agent as advice. But training on such trajectories can make the model rely on advice that is unavailable at test time, creating a train-test mismatch. Instead, we argue that history should guide where collection effort is spent, while the coding agent decides what to generate. We introduce SWE-Trail, a trajectory collector that uses earlier trajectories to guide subsequent collection while keeping that history outside the coding agent's context. During a new rollout, SWE-Trail uses history to identify a state where additional collection effort may be useful. There, the coding agent proposes candidate next actions from its ordinary context, and SWE-Trail briefly executes them from the same checkpoint to decide which route continues. We evaluate collection approaches by training student models on the trajectories they produce. For a 124B student initialized from Ling-3.0-flash-base, SWE-Trail improves mean resolution over independent sampling by 2.33 and 1.60 percentage points on SWE-bench Multilingual and SWE-bench Pro, respectively. Without history, the same pipeline produces more resolved trajectories than independent sampling, but improves by only 0.11 points on Multilingual. These results show the value of using history to guide collection without exposing it to the coding agent.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SWE-Trail，用先前轨迹定位值得追加收集投入的状态，由 coding agent 依自身普通上下文提出候选动作，再由收集器在同一检查点短暂执行各候选以决定走哪条路线，历史始终不进入 agent 上下文，并以训练学生模型的解题率评估收集方式。
AI.relevance_reason: 「历史只用于决定在何处分支搜索与验证、不暴露给模型」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹收集中的训练-测试不匹配、计算投入分配与样本贡献归因问题。
